---
title: "Found Kittens?"
---

If you found healthy kittens under 8 weeks old, please [Leave Them Be](http://www.alleycat.org/LeaveThemBe)! Even if they're alone, their mom is likely still caring for them and will be back soon.

**If you are worried about [tiny, neonatal kittens]{.underline} (under 2 lbs), complete the questions below.**

We can provide guidance about the kittens' ages, care needs, and whether removing them from their environment is appropriate (for example: if they are sick or injured). We can also connect you with other local resources. In some cases, we can offer limited veterinary services while the kittens are outside to improve their welfare while they await rescue.

::: callout-important
This form is for receiving guidance, **not** for requesting surrender or TNR. To request direct assistance from our organization, please complete our [Request Form](https://www.clecatproject.org/requesthelp) instead.
:::
